title: Globex expansion sync
transcript:
Priya: Quote for the audit-log add-on goes out Friday at twenty-four. Floor is nineteen.
Sam: Understood. Engineering-wise they bring up the argument-truncation bug every call. Lindqvist filed it and it's genuinely hurting their retrieval tool.
Priya: And their eval team lost a week to the silent model fallback. If we fix those two before the November renewal the expansion sells itself.
Sam: Invoice-wise 1041 is open with the usage overage. They're net-30 and slow, but they always pay.
Priya: Not worried. Chase it after the twentieth if it's still sitting.
